entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, cat. X, excluded beers with an actual alcoholic strength by volume > 0.5% vol. and other drinks with an actual alcoholic strength by volume > 1.2% vol. 
The reduced rate only applies for: 
- certain products not classified as beverages within the meaning of the exc. in 1302 1100 up to and including 1302 1970 
- pectic substances for the manufacture of jams and jellies in 1302 2010 15, 1302 2010 69, 1302 2010 79, 1302 2090 20, 1302 2090 69, 1302 2090 99
